subject: Authorized implementation: scoped reference map and separate character/scene validation
body:
Ziggy authorizes the bounded reference-validation engineering implementation described in the attached shared foundation, folded into the existing integration discussion. CFA Nova owns code/methods/intake and serialized publication at its natural checkpoint after current scoring/generation; no current job interruption. Separate CHARACTER and SCENE evidence indicators beside their existing stars; preserve manual/provider reviews and legacy verification stages, with no fabricated AI passes. Use actual scoped reference hashes/versions, criteria/tolerances and images-seen evidence; missing/offscreen required features cannot pass, and reference changes require recheck. Hon's recurring cockpit layout is constrained where locked; Lisan's open environments have no invented fixed home.

The inventory carries all 18 existing BOM rows with verified bytes and canonical review fields, without new gold selection. Eight have explicit selections; ten scoped Production options still need family/default reconciliation. Family/derivative gaps are recorded. Newcomer vision is UNTESTED, not proven unavailable; Claude's nine suggestions remain proposals. This creates no model activation or image/video jobs.

CFA: implement/test the reversible sidecar/UI and safe legacy transition; update central methods/carepack/reviewer wrappers through owners; return preservation/tests/publication evidence. Claude: reconcile creative scoped criteria and your own guidance. HaL: incorporate reference IDs/hashes/scopes and required/optional/tolerated distinctions in future already-authorized handoffs; no new generation or current batch change. Existing alien-dog results should be located and shown, not regenerated or auto-nominated.

Reply in this shared mailbox with this conversationId and replyTo. Posted is not delivery/read/implementation. Correlation: REFERENCE-MAP-TWO-AXIS-VALIDATION-20261013
